title: Refactor: extract call_local_api helper in kith-tslocal
description:
What: The ~38-line HTTP/1.1 transport block (connect socket, write request, read response, parse body) is copy-pasted between status() and whois() in kith-tslocal/src/lib.rs. Extract it into a private async fn call_local_api(socket_path, uri, max_bytes) -> Result<Bytes, AuthError>.

Algorithm:
1. Read lib.rs in full; identify the two duplicate transport blocks
2. Write private async fn call_local_api(socket_path: &Path, uri: &str, max_bytes: usize) -> Result<Bytes, AuthError>:
   - UnixStream::connect, timeout, HTTP/1.1 handshake, send_request, await response, read body with limit
   - Error prefixes: 'connect: {e}', 'handshake: {e}', 'request: {e}', 'body: {e}' (already standardized)
3. Replace both call sites with call_local_api(...)
4. Ensure the max_bytes parameter is used (whois has a tighter bound than status)

Defensive programming rules:
- Keep the exact same error prefix strings already standardized in KITH-626.10 to avoid breaking tests
- Do not change the public function signatures of status() or whois()
- Run cargo test -p kith-tslocal to confirm integration tests still pass

Agent team: single R+I+T agent (one crate, one file)

Tests:
- cargo test -p kith-tslocal passes unchanged
- cargo build -p kith-tslocal --all-features -D warnings passes
